text:
Maya Singh: Partner asks for a short 'CI + secrets' playbook for marketplace onboarding. They want recommended patterns for: (1) repo secrets, (2) signing/artifact provenance, (3) ephemeral credentials for e2e smoke runs, (4) SRE-safe rollback on failed deploy. Can we sketch this here?
Ethan Liu: yes. short answer: use repo-level secrets only for non-prod tokens, implement ephemeral runner creds via GitHub OIDC -> STS role, and store long-term keys in partner KMS/Vault. avoid baking creds into AMIs.
Carlos Mendes: +1. also recommend signed container images (cosign) and attestations (in-toto) for marketplace artifacts. partner marketplaces often require provenance.
Maya Singh: good. partner is specifically worried about how CI in their marketplace pipeline will pull model artifacts (weights) and deploy them without exposing s3 keys.
Priya Kapoor: action: produce a 1-page playbook + example GH Action + minimal Terraform to create the IAM trust. I'll own wording for partner compliance.
Ethan Liu: sample GH Action snippet we can include (OIDC -> short-lived creds):
```yaml
name: smoke-deploy
on: [workflow_dispatch]
permissions: id-token: write
jobs:
  assume:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Request OIDC token and assume role
        run: |
          export AWS_ROLE_ARN=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/marketplace-deploy-role
          aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn $AWS_ROLE_ARN --role-session-name ci-session --web-identity-token $ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN
      - name: deploy
        run: ./scripts/deploy-smoke.sh
```
Maya Singh: we'll need the Terraform to create the role + trust policy pointing to GH repo. keep scope narrow: only ability to PutObject to a specific prefix + SSM parameter access for endpoint.
Carlos Mendes: and include a terraform snippet to create an S3 presign gateway for model pulls to avoid direct S3 creds in partner infra. presigned URLs with short TTL.
Maya Singh: boolean: should we recommend SOPS (GPG/KMS) for any long-lived secret files checked into the example repo? Partner legal asked about key rotation.
Ethan Liu: yes but prefer not to check decrypted secrets anywhere. SOPS + KMS envelope encryption is fine for small bootstrapping values. Document rotation cadence (90 days) and show how to rekey.
Priya Kapoor: compliance note: partner marketplaces request SBOM & signature metadata. We'll include a small section on generating SBOM (syft) and signing images (cosign) and attaching provenance files to the marketplace package.
Carlos Mendes: automated smoke test should: (1) fetch model via presigned URL, (2) start local inference server, (3) hit /health and /v1/generate with a known prompt, (4) post results to partner test endpoint. keep the test < 2 mins.
Maya Singh: include sample smoke script skeleton:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# fetch model
curl -sSL "${PRESIGNED_URL}" -o model.tar.gz
# unpack and start container
docker run -d --rm -p 8080:8080 --name smoke redwood/inference:canary
# poll health
curl -f http://localhost:8080/health && \
  curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .
```
Ethan Liu: CI should gate: terraform fmt/validate/plan (no secrets output), image signature verification (cosign verify), and smoke job using ephemeral creds. If anything fails, the workflow should auto-revoke the assumed role session and create a JIRA ticket via API.
Priya Kapoor: Partner CI Bot: can you attach the marketplace packaging checklist we keep?
Partner CI Bot: marketplace-bot: attached checklist link: https://git.internal/redwood/partnerships/marketplace-cookbook/CI_SECRETS_PLAYBOOK.md
Carlos Mendes: last call: include guidance for private-only endpoints. For private deployments, presigned URLs still ok but must be served from partner's internal proxy; document a swap for 'internal artifact mirror' step.
Maya Singh: perfect. I'll draft the playbook and push to branch partnerships/marketplace-ci-playbook/1747019999 and tag team for review. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Ethan Liu: I'll add Terraform + GH Action example.
Priya Kapoor: thanks all. I'll coordinate partner legal review and sign-off. If someone wants to rephrase anything for the customer-facing doc, ping me. :white_check_mark:
